tags.title: Tags
tags.subtitle: The tag taxonomy. Tags are the foundation of automatic answer matching and the Deep Research source map.
tags.taxonomyNotice: A tag in use is never deleted, only deactivated — so the tags on past records stay intact.
tags.liveSourceWarning: Tag reads and writes go to different sources (see NEXT_PUBLIC_KNOWLEDGE_LIVE_ENDPOINTS). A tag you add or change here may not appear in the list. Until both point at the same source, changes made here are unreliable.
tags.liveContractNotice: Tags are written to the live backend. Its contract stores only the tag NAME: there is no category or status field, so a tag cannot be deactivated and permanent deletion is the only way to remove one. Usage is not counted by the backend either, so it shows as “—”.
